 The New Indian Express appoints Ravi Shankar as Editor
 The New Indian Express appoints Ravi Shankar as Editor
 Kiran Prakash MS has been named Executive Editor of the daily and the Sunday edition 
 by
 e4m Desk
 Published: 
 Nov 11, 2026 8:13 AM 
 | 
 1 min read 
 Follow Us 
 The New Indian Express has appointed Ravi Shankar as Editor and Kiran Prakash MS as Executive Editor of the newspaper and its Sunday edition.  
 The appointments were announced by Manoj Kumar Sonthalia, Chairman and Managing Director of the organisation, with both editors taking charge with immediate effect. 
 --> 
 --> 
 Ravi Shankar has been associated with The New Indian Express for over two decades. Until recently, Shankar served as Consulting Editor – Sunday Magazine.  
 --> 
 -->
 Kiran Prakash MS has been with the organisation for over a decade and previously served as Resident Editor – Kerala.
